basis.scale: HB134 pixel spans are registered to the retained 148 mm channel depth and saved upper/lower web separation. This is conditional registration, not printed metrology; image X increases aft.
basis.source_axis_px: Held-out visible shaft center; record its residual against the modeled shaft instead of forcing alignment. Pixel picks have an estimated +/-4 px allowance.
basis.source_foot_x_px: Upper foot extent read behind partly obscuring channel/link lines; profile approximated by a flat rectangular foot.
basis.source_lug_x_px: Visible lug width; circular bottom inferred behind the link head.
basis.source_foot_stock_px: 13 source pixels; estimated foot thickness, not a printed stock dimension.
basis.lug_stock: 12.7 mm estimated transverse thickness; cannot be measured from the available side view.
basis.foot_width: 60 mm estimated transverse width; no width in side view.
basis.pin_bore_diameter: 24 mm estimated intended pin diameter; M339 source gives identity/count but no located dimension.
basis.pin_bore_clearance: 0.15 mm radial geometric allowance, not historical manufacturing tolerance.
basis.stop: L-section interpretation of M385 in HB135. Length scales from the visible tip to the registered frame web spacing; toe depth, transverse width and stock are estimated.
basis.axial_offset: Zero means align bracket and stop with the center of the corresponding cylindrical friction face; linkage stack not yet qualified.
basis.pin_drop_adjustment: Zero nominal. Explicit variation control for ambiguous hidden lug geometry.
basis.longitudinal_datum: Locate M338 pin longitudinally from the retained drum shaft and HB134 pin-to-shaft separation. The initial channel-referenced X placement collided with diaphragm/stops. The 9.576 mm datum disagreement remains explicit; not a historical fit claim.
